alt: A line graph with time in seconds along the bottom, running from 0 to 10, and altitude in meters up the side, running from 0 to 200 and marked every 20. Four points are plotted and joined in order: 0 meters at 0 seconds, 120 meters at 3 seconds, 200 meters at 7 seconds, and 80 meters at 10 seconds. The line climbs to its highest point at 7 seconds, then falls to 10 seconds.
